High uric acid is not just about joint pain. When uric acid builds up, it can form crystals around the joints, triggering gout attacks, and may also contribute to uric-acid kidney stones. The good news is that everyday food and lifestyle choices can support healthier uric acid levels. In this video, Hansaji explains how to manage uric acid naturally through diet, hydration, yoga and sustainable lifestyle habits.
